paragraphs: Mentioned in [Yoma 87a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.87a.9), raising a difficulty before Rabbi Abbahu. There, according to Hyman’s report of the Ein Yaakov reading, he states the rule that ten people are brought to a person's grave to ask his forgiveness. Yuchasin reads Rav Yosef bar Chavush Maya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked exchange names Rav Yosef bar Chavu as Rabbi Abbahu’s questioner. In the consulted edition, [the grave ruling](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.87a.13) is part of a statement attributed to Rabbi Yosei bar Chanina.

Hyman reports Rav Yosef bar Chavu as the transmitter in Ein Yaakov. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2018&lang=en) also gives that attribution and discusses the longer heading Chavush Maya.
